name: header-minimal
title: Minimal header
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A single quiet row: name, two to five links and an optional action. Links wrap onto their own row on narrow screens instead of hiding in a menu.

meta.useWhen: There are only a few destinations and every one should stay visible, especially on phones.
meta.avoidWhen: There are more than five links, or the header should overlay imagery.
